test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A train covers a distance of 10 km in 10 minutes. If its speed is decreased by 20 km/h, then the time taken by it to cover the same distance will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 10 km

Initial time = 10 minutes = 10/60 hours = 1/6 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Initial Speed = 10 km / (1/6) hours

Initial Speed = 10 × 6 = 60 km/h

Decreased Speed = 60 km/h - 20 km/h = 40 km/h

Time taken to cover the same distance with decreased speed

Time = Distance / Speed

Time = 10 km / 40 km/h

Time = 1/4 hours

Time = (1/4) × 60 minutes

Time = 15 minutes

**The time taken by the train to cover the same distance with decreased speed is 15 minutes.**
